# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m158 engine update**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.158 line adopts Skia m158 while preserving the existing managed binding surface. The collected changes also correct calling conventions in source-generated native imports. Native HarfBuzz remains at 14.4.0; its package revision changes do not represent an engine upgrade.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment targets** — Graphite Metal adopts an iOS and tvOS runtime minimum of 15; raise deployment targets for applications using this backend where necessary. Its macOS minimum remains 12. Retain any higher managed or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Advances the native renderer through m157 to m158 without adding C bridge exports or changing the managed binding surface. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542), [#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## Bug Fixes

- **Explicit cdecl imports** — Source-generated LibraryImport declarations now use the same cdecl convention as the existing import and delegate paths, correcting an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86 calls. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))
